parameters.query: SELECT m.id::text, m.owner_id::text, u.display_name AS owner_name, m.display_name, m.imap_host, m.imap_port, m.imap_username, m.ssl_enabled, m.sync_interval, m.start_date::text, m.status, m.mails_indexed, m.last_synced_at::text, m.last_error, m.next_sync_at::text, m.created_at::text, m.updated_at::text, COALESCE(JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('user_id', a.user_id::text, 'display_name', au.display_name, 'username', au.username)) FILTER (WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) AS access_users FROM alice.imap_mailboxes m LEFT JOIN alice.users u ON u.id = m.owner_id LEFT JOIN alice.imap_mailbox_access a ON a.mailbox_id = m.id LEFT JOIN alice.users au ON au.id = a.user_id WHERE (m.owner_id = $1::uuid OR $2 = 'admin') GROUP BY m.id, u.display_name ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
